=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- `.github/workflows/plan.yml:~922-942,~1180-1200` | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The plan workflow scans and hashes `.git/**` during both snapshot steps, making every plan run expensive on repositories with non-trivial git object trees.
  WHY: The reviewer classified this as a major regression because the repeated `find .git ...` traversal can push the plan job over its wall-time budget.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Allow plan-phase writes to pass when confined to the designated allowed globs
  expected_change_site: `.github/ai/write_guards.v1.json`
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  EVIDENCE: no gap — policy already defines allowed glob `/__write_guard_plan_no_repo_writes__/**`, which blocks all real repo writes
- requirement: Out-of-policy plan-phase writes must fail with WRITE_GUARD_BLOCK signal
  expected_change_site: `.github/workflows/plan.yml` post-Codex guard enforcement step
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  EVIDENCE: no gap — post-Codex step captures git changes, runs `write_guard_check plan`, and exits 1 when policy is violated, emitting PLAN_FAILURE_CONTEXT and WRITE_GUARD_BLOCK-level error
- requirement: WRITE_GUARDS_ENABLED=false must bypass the guard and log WRITE_GUARD_BYPASS_ENV
  expected_change_site: `.github/workflows/plan.yml` guard enforcement environment handling
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  EVIDENCE: no gap — plan.yml sets WRITE_GUARDS_ENABLED from vars, guard sources write_guard.sh only when enabled, and `write_guard_check` explicitly checks env; tests confirm bypass works
- requirement: The change must extend coverage to plan phase with no manual operator step
  expected_change_site: `.github/workflows/plan.yml`, `.github/ai/write_guards.v1.json`, `scripts/dev/test_write_guard.sh`, and vars plumbing
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  EVIDENCE: no gap — policy added for plan phase, workflow stages write_guard.sh and sets WRITE_GUARDS_ENABLED=true by default; tests added; README updated; all changes are automatic and do not require manual steps
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
